svg.text: Slow Stored Procedure Playbook – Visual Guide
SQL · S09 · Reproduce → actual plan → waits → one change → measure
Five steps. An index is step four, not step one.
Plan, waits, then one change with numbers after.
Missing-index hints are hypotheses. Sniffing is S10.
Do not start with CREATE INDEX on every column.
STATISTICS IO/TIME before and after the same params.
CPU time = 940 ms, elapsed time = 2100 ms
CPU time = 15 ms, elapsed time = 22 ms
MiniProfiler is not an actual plan. Still measure both.
